## Description {#details}

<p>This provides the default implementation of the <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/irbuilder">IRBuilder</a> 'InsertHelper' method that is called whenever an instruction is created by <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/irbuilder">IRBuilder</a> and needs to be inserted.</p>


<p>By default, this inserts the instruction at the insertion point.</p>


<p>Definition at line 60 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/ir/irbuilder-h">IRBuilder.h</a>.</p>
